string.name: draw_desc
string.value: Draw path, text and image onto a RenderNode through Node-API.

string.name: primitive_desc
string.value: Point, line, circle, oval, rect, round rect, arc, path and region.

string.name: effect_desc
string.value: Fill and stroke, blend mode, dash, gradients, color filter and mask blur.

string.name: transform_desc
string.value: Clip, translate, rotate, scale, matrix and save/restore.

string.name: image_desc
string.value: Draw a pixel map with different sampling modes and a scale view.

string.name: text_desc
string.value: TextBlob, typography layout and text measurement.

string.name: node_tree_desc
string.value: Append and remove child render nodes at runtime.

string.name: render_property_desc
string.value: Toggle background color, opacity, clip, shadow, scale and rotation.

string.name: blur_desc
string.value: Background, content and foreground blur supported since API 26.

string.name: lifecycle_desc
string.value: Set label, invalidate, dispose and recreate the render node.

string.name: capability_desc
string.value: Schema driven demos across 19 capability families: canvas, paint, bitmap, text, shadow, matrix, record, offscreen layer and error codes.

string.name: catalog_desc
string.value: Schema driven demos: each group renders every native drawing capability of one header family.

string.name: topic_catalog_desc
string.value: Node level topics: tree, properties, blur, animation, hit testing, performance, record and device fit.

string.name: topic_desc
string.value: Ten node level topics: tree, properties, blur, animation, hit testing, performance, record, device fit, lifecycle and frame tick.

string.name: cap_bitmap_group_desc
string.value: Build, draw, scale, read back, create from pixels, inspect format and tile a bitmap.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s00_desc
string.value: Build an empty bitmap, bind an offscreen canvas, then blit it back.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s01_desc
string.value: DrawBitmap keeps one bitmap pixel per canvas pixel, no scaling.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s02_desc
string.value: Stretch one bitmap into different target rects with sampling.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s03_desc
string.value: Read the bitmap pixels back and repaint them as colour blocks.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s04_desc
string.value: Create a bitmap straight from memory pixels, skipping the canvas.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s05_desc
string.value: Read width, height and format, then draw by the reported ratio.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s06_desc
string.value: Premultiplied and unpremultiplied differ on translucent fills.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s07_desc
string.value: The same memory read as RGBA or BGRA shows a channel swap.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s08_desc
string.value: Row bytes set the memory stride, stripes show the format gap.

string.name: cap_bitmap_s09_desc
string.value: Repeat a small bitmap across the canvas with one sampling option.

string.name: cap_canvas_group_desc
string.value: Clear, batch points, save/restore, four clip modes, translate, skew and layer.

string.name: cap_canvas_s00_desc
string.value: Clear the canvas then overlay a translucent block and a circle.

string.name: cap_canvas_s01_desc
string.value: Submit a whole grid of vertices with one DrawPoints call.

string.name: cap_canvas_s02_desc
string.value: Rotate inside a save block and restore back to the previous state.

string.name: cap_canvas_s03_desc
string.value: Clip to an inset rectangle, then draw stripes across the canvas.

string.name: cap_canvas_s04_desc
string.value: Clip to a rounded rectangle before drawing rings.

string.name: cap_canvas_s05_desc
string.value: Clip along a regular polygon path with adjustable sides.

string.name: cap_canvas_s06_desc
string.value: Clip to the difference of two regions.

string.name: cap_canvas_s07_desc
string.value: Apply the same translation three times to separate the blocks.

string.name: cap_canvas_s08_desc
string.value: Skew the coordinate system by an angle, converted to tangent internally.

string.name: cap_canvas_s09_desc
string.value: Composite two circles in a layer, then blend the layer once.

string.name: cap_color_group_desc
string.value: Palette, alpha ramp, channel mixing, ARGB / RGBA order, contrast, invert and gamma.

string.name: cap_color_s00_desc
string.value: Lay out the built-in palette with the chosen count and alpha.

string.name: cap_color_s01_desc
string.value: One color spread across evenly spaced alpha steps.

string.name: cap_color_s02_desc
string.value: Interpolate between two palette colors by ratio.

string.name: cap_color_s03_desc
string.value: Unpack A / R / G / B and rebuild the color in the same order.

string.name: cap_color_s04_desc
string.value: Rebuild the color in R / G / B / A order to show channel shift.

string.name: cap_color_s05_desc
string.value: Scale every channel around 128, 1.0 keeps the original color.

string.name: cap_color_s06_desc
string.value: Mix the color towards its complement by ratio.

string.name: cap_color_filter_group_desc
string.value: Blend mode filter, four color matrices, luma, compose, lighting and pen level filter.

string.name: cap_color_filter_s00_desc
string.value: Blend a solid color onto the palette strip with the chosen mode.

string.name: cap_color_filter_s01_desc
string.value: Saturation matrix, 0 is fully gray and 100 keeps the color.

string.name: cap_color_filter_s03_desc
string.value: Invert matrix, 100 is the full complementary color.

string.name: cap_color_filter_s04_desc
string.value: Contrast matrix around the middle gray point.

string.name: cap_color_filter_s05_desc
string.value: Built-in luma filter compared with the unfiltered block.

string.name: cap_color_filter_s06_desc
string.value: Two filters chained, the outer one works on the inner result.

string.name: cap_color_filter_s07_desc
string.value: Multiply and add colors decide the final brightness.

string.name: cap_color_filter_s08_desc
string.value: Unfiltered frame versus a pen carrying an invert filter.

string.name: cap_error_group_desc
string.value: Read and reset the code after null, invalid, success and failure, plus guarded flows.

string.name: cap_error_s00_desc
string.value: After a reset the code reads zero, a second read confirms it.

string.name: cap_error_s01_desc
string.value: Calling an interface with null returns the invalid parameter code.

string.name: cap_error_s02_desc
string.value: Start a recording with a negative size and read the code back.

string.name: cap_error_s03_desc
string.value: A run of successful calls must leave the code untouched.

string.name: cap_error_s04_desc
string.value: The code stays until it is read or reset, success will not clear it.

string.name: cap_error_s05_desc
string.value: Reset after a failure and normal drawing works again.

string.name: cap_error_s06_desc
string.value: Common codes drawn as bars, the height is scaled by the code.

string.name: cap_error_s07_desc
string.value: Clamp the size first, only a legal rect reaches RectCreate.

string.name: cap_error_s08_desc
string.value: Every matrix step is checked, the first failure stops the flow.

string.name: cap_error_s09_desc
string.value: Run a set of independent checks and show the result as a grid.

string.name: cap_font_group_desc
string.value: Size, measure, metrics, skew, fake bold, scale X, hinting, edging and text outlines.

string.name: cap_font_s00_desc
string.value: Create a font, set the size and draw a baseline sample.

string.name: cap_font_s01_desc
string.value: Two sizes of the same font show the glyph and line gap change.

string.name: cap_font_s02_desc
string.value: MeasureText reports the width, a box is drawn at that width.

string.name: cap_font_s03_desc
string.value: Draw the top, ascent, descent and bottom guides from the metrics.

string.name: cap_font_s04_desc
string.value: SetTextSkewX slants the glyph along X, negative leans left.

string.name: cap_font_s05_desc
string.value: FakeBold thickens the glyph without loading another font file.

string.name: cap_font_s06_desc
string.value: SetScaleX stretches only the glyph width, the size stays.

string.name: cap_font_s07_desc
string.value: Higher hinting aligns small glyphs to the pixel grid.

string.name: cap_font_s08_desc
string.value: Alias, anti alias and subpixel give different edge quality.

string.name: cap_font_s09_desc
string.value: GetTextPath returns the outline, filled and stroked here.

string.name: cap_font_s10_desc
string.value: Count the system font families and draw the first family name.

string.name: cap_font_s11_desc
string.value: TypefaceCreateDefault attaches the default glyph family.

string.name: cap_geometry_group_desc
string.value: Rect, round rect, nested round rect, oval, arcs, lines, polygon, bezier and boolean ops.

string.name: cap_geometry_s00_desc
string.value: Fill and stroke a rectangle sized by percentages.

string.name: cap_geometry_s01_desc
string.value: Uniform corner radius with one corner enlarged by SetCorner.

string.name: cap_geometry_s02_desc
string.value: Draw an outer and an inner rounded rectangle in one call.

string.name: cap_geometry_s03_desc
string.value: Horizontal and vertical radii are controlled separately.

string.name: cap_geometry_s04_desc
string.value: Stroke an arc without connecting the center.

string.name: cap_geometry_s05_desc
string.value: Toggle useCenter to switch between arc and pie.

string.name: cap_geometry_s06_desc
string.value: Three parallel lines shifted by a diagonal offset.

string.name: cap_geometry_s07_desc
string.value: Regular polygon path, closed polygons are also filled.

string.name: cap_geometry_s08_desc
string.value: Quadratic and cubic curves side by side with adjustable curvature.

string.name: cap_geometry_s09_desc
string.value: Combine two circle paths with a boolean operation.

string.name: cap_geometry_s10_desc
string.value: Combine two rect regions, then export the boundary path.

string.name: cap_image_filter_group_desc
string.value: Blur, crop, offset, color matrix, shader wrap, lattice and three tile modes on drawn content.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s00_desc
string.value: Separate X and Y sigma, and pick how the blur extends past the edge.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s01_desc
string.value: Crop the blurred result so the glow stops at the crop rect.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s02_desc
string.value: Shift the painted content to build a drop shadow or a ghost.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s03_desc
string.value: Wrap a color filter as an image filter limited to the shape.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s04_desc
string.value: Wrap a sweep gradient shader as an image filter for the shape.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s05_desc
string.value: Create and destroy a lattice, the grid visualises the division count.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s06_desc
string.value: Clamp repeats the edge pixels beyond the source bounds.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s07_desc
string.value: Repeat wraps the source so blurred corners fold back inside.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s08_desc
string.value: Mirror folds the source back on itself at each edge.

string.name: cap_image_filter_s09_desc
string.value: The whole layer is drawn first, then filtered as one image.

string.name: cap_image_io_group_desc
string.value: Image creation, source rect mapping, sampling, alpha copy, and memory streams for fonts.

string.name: cap_image_io_s00_desc
string.value: Build a bitmap, wrap it as an Image, then draw it in the centre.

string.name: cap_image_io_s01_desc
string.value: Draw the whole Image into a target rect, no source cropping.

string.name: cap_image_io_s02_desc
string.value: Map only the middle of the source onto the target rect.

string.name: cap_image_io_s03_desc
string.value: Read width, height and alpha type, then mark the ratio.

string.name: cap_image_io_s04_desc
string.value: Magnify with nearest filtering to keep hard pixel edges.

string.name: cap_image_io_s05_desc
string.value: Magnify with linear filtering for a smoother result.

string.name: cap_image_io_s06_desc
string.value: Draw the image inside a translucent layer so it blends.

string.name: cap_image_io_s07_desc
string.value: Wrap a memory buffer as a stream, block count sets its length.

string.name: cap_image_io_s08_desc
string.value: Build a typeface from font file bytes through a memory stream.

string.name: cap_image_io_s09_desc
string.value: Invalid bytes fail to parse and the default glyph takes over.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_group_desc
string.value: Four blur types, a sigma ladder, and the same filter attached to pen, layer and text.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_s00_desc
string.value: Blur both sides of the edge, the classic soft glow.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_s01_desc
string.value: Keep the fill sharp and blur only outside, a hard edged glow.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_s02_desc
string.value: Blur spreads outward only, the shape body stays transparent inside.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_s03_desc
string.value: Blur spreads inward only, the outer edge stays clean.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_s04_desc
string.value: Put two sigma values side by side to compare the spread.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_s05_desc
string.value: Attach the filter to a pen and stroke a polygon path.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_s06_desc
string.value: SaveLayer with a masked brush blurs the whole layer at once.

string.name: cap_mask_filter_s07_desc
string.value: TextBlob glyphs are blurred because the brush carries the filter.

string.name: cap_matrix_group_desc
string.value: Identity, translate, scale, rotate, skew, concat, pre post order, invert, map points, poly to poly.

string.name: cap_matrix_s00_desc
string.value: No transform, and the nine elements are drawn as bars.

string.name: cap_matrix_s01_desc
string.value: CreateTranslation builds the shift directly, the arrow shows it.

string.name: cap_matrix_s02_desc
string.value: CreateScale around a pivot so the marker never leaves the canvas.

string.name: cap_matrix_s03_desc
string.value: CreateRotation around a point, the angle may be negative.

string.name: cap_matrix_s04_desc
string.value: PreSkew takes a tangent, the angle is converted first.

string.name: cap_matrix_s05_desc
string.value: Two matrices merged by Concat match applying them one by one.

string.name: cap_matrix_s06_desc
string.value: The same two steps in the other order land in a different place.

string.name: cap_matrix_s07_desc
string.value: Apply a rotation then its inverse, the points come back home.

string.name: cap_matrix_s08_desc
string.value: MapPoints transforms a batch of points, lines show the shift.

string.name: cap_matrix_s09_desc
string.value: SetPolyToPoly maps a rect onto an irregular quadrilateral.

string.name: cap_paint_group_desc
string.value: Cap, join, miter limit, width, brush alpha, blend mode, path effects and shadow layer.

string.name: cap_paint_s00_desc
string.value: flat / square / round caps on thick lines, the selected one is highlighted.

string.name: cap_paint_s01_desc
string.value: miter / round / bevel joins on the same zigzag path.

string.name: cap_paint_s02_desc
string.value: Miter limit controls how far a sharp corner may extend.

string.name: cap_paint_s03_desc
string.value: Four lines scaled from the base width with a shared alpha.

string.name: cap_paint_s04_desc
string.value: Overlapping translucent blocks show how alpha accumulates.

string.name: cap_paint_s05_desc
string.value: Blend the top block onto the base block with the selected mode.

string.name: cap_paint_s06_desc
string.value: Dash path effect built from alternating dash and gap lengths.

string.name: cap_paint_s07_desc
string.value: Corner path effect rounds every joint of a polyline.

string.name: cap_paint_s08_desc
string.value: Discrete path effect adds jitter along the stroke.

string.name: cap_paint_s09_desc
string.value: Blur radius and offset of the brush shadow layer.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_group_desc
string.value: Draw, sample, nine patch, mesh warp, rotate, tile, fade, scale and clip a PixelMap.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s00_desc
string.value: Blit the whole PixelMap into a centred rect with a sampling mode.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s01_desc
string.value: Zoom in with nearest filtering, hard pixel edges are kept.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s02_desc
string.value: The same zoom with linear filtering shows a smooth result.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s03_desc
string.value: Take only the middle of the source, strict rejects oversampling.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s04_desc
string.value: The centre rect stretches while the four corners keep their pixels.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s05_desc
string.value: Move the middle row of a 3x3 mesh to bend the image.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s06_desc
string.value: Rotate the coordinate system, then blit the original rect.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s07_desc
string.value: Repeat the same PixelMap across a square grid.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s08_desc
string.value: Fade the PixelMap through the alpha of a SaveLayer brush.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s09_desc
string.value: Grow the target rect to inspect sampling while scaling.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s10_desc
string.value: Clip to a rounded rect before the blit, corners are cut away.

string.name: cap_pixel_map_s11_desc
string.value: Placeholder drawn when no PixelMap is handed over from ArkTS.

string.name: cap_record_group_desc
string.value: Record a command list once, then replay it as is, twice, nested, resized, layered and overlaid.

string.name: cap_record_s00_desc
string.value: Record a group of draw commands and replay once, same as direct draw.

string.name: cap_record_s01_desc
string.value: Canvas transforms applied while recording replay with the list.

string.name: cap_record_s02_desc
string.value: Replay the same list twice, the second one shifted for contrast.

string.name: cap_record_s03_desc
string.value: Record an inner list, then draw it into an outer recording.

string.name: cap_record_s04_desc
string.value: Record at a smaller size and replay scaled up, the list stays neutral.

string.name: cap_record_s05_desc
string.value: A SaveLayer inside the list keeps its alpha when replayed.

string.name: cap_record_s06_desc
string.value: Many save and restore pairs are replayed in the same order.

string.name: cap_record_s07_desc
string.value: Replay the list at growing offsets to build a trailing ghost.

string.name: cap_shader_group_desc
string.value: Linear, multi stop, radial, sweep, conical, color, compose, pen shader, matrix and tiling.

string.name: cap_shader_s00_desc
string.value: Two color linear gradient with adjustable angle and alpha.

string.name: cap_shader_s01_desc
string.value: Two to six color stops interpolated between the palette ends.

string.name: cap_shader_s02_desc
string.value: Radial gradient with an adjustable radius and center.

string.name: cap_shader_s03_desc
string.value: Sweep gradient, the start angle rotates the color stops.

string.name: cap_shader_s04_desc
string.value: Two point conical gradient with an inner radius.

string.name: cap_shader_s05_desc
string.value: A solid color used as a shader effect.

string.name: cap_shader_s06_desc
string.value: Compose a gradient with a translucent color shader.

string.name: cap_shader_s07_desc
string.value: Gradient applied to the stroke geometry.

string.name: cap_shader_s08_desc
string.value: Scale and rotate the gradient through a local matrix.

string.name: cap_shader_s09_desc
string.value: Clamp, repeat, mirror and decal decide the area outside the gradient.

string.name: cap_shader_s10_desc
string.value: Different alpha at both ends creates a fade out.

string.name: cap_shadow_group_desc
string.value: Blur radius, offset, colour, pen and brush shadows, stacked shadows and layer clipping.

string.name: cap_shadow_s00_desc
string.value: Three blur radii side by side show how far the shadow spreads.

string.name: cap_shadow_s01_desc
string.value: The offset moves the shadow, negative values put it up left.

string.name: cap_shadow_s02_desc
string.value: The shadow colour and alpha together set the final look.

string.name: cap_shadow_s03_desc
string.value: PenSetShadowLayer puts a shadow under stroked paths.

string.name: cap_shadow_s04_desc
string.value: BrushSetShadowLayer is the usual way to cast a drop shadow.

string.name: cap_shadow_s05_desc
string.value: Three concentric shapes carry different blur radii.

string.name: cap_shadow_s06_desc
string.value: A text blob painted by a shadowed brush casts a shadow.

string.name: cap_shadow_s07_desc
string.value: SaveLayer clips the shadow to the layer bounds.

string.name: cap_offscreen_group_desc
string.value: Create a GPU offscreen layer, size it, fall back to a bitmap, flush, switch, clip, blend and read info.

string.name: cap_offscreen_s00_desc
string.value: Create a GPU context and an offscreen layer, paint on it, then destroy both.

string.name: cap_offscreen_s01_desc
string.value: The inner frame scales with the offscreen layer size so the ratio is visible.

string.name: cap_offscreen_s02_desc
string.value: When no GPU offscreen layer is available a bitmap plus canvas is used.

string.name: cap_offscreen_s03_desc
string.value: Paint and flush several times, the bar count follows the parameter.

string.name: cap_offscreen_s04_desc
string.value: Destroy one offscreen layer then create a smaller one to prove reuse works.

string.name: cap_offscreen_s05_desc
string.value: Clip on the offscreen layer canvas, the clip belongs to that canvas alone.

string.name: cap_offscreen_s06_desc
string.value: Overlay translucent blocks on the offscreen layer, mirrored on the main canvas.

string.name: cap_offscreen_s07_desc
string.value: Read the offscreen layer canvas size and image info, drawn as bars and a block.

string.name: cap_text_blob_group_desc
string.value: Build text blobs from strings, byte ranges, per glyph positions, a run builder and a circle.

string.name: cap_text_blob_s00_desc
string.value: CreateFromString parses the UTF-8 text in one call.

string.name: cap_text_blob_s01_desc
string.value: CreateFromText takes only the leading bytes, useful for truncation.

string.name: cap_text_blob_s02_desc
string.value: Give every glyph its own position so the text follows a sine wave.

string.name: cap_text_blob_s03_desc
string.value: Fill a run buffer with glyphs and points, then BuilderMake.

string.name: cap_text_blob_s04_desc
string.value: Stroke the rect returned by GetBounds to check the real extent.

string.name: cap_text_blob_s05_desc
string.value: UniqueID is non zero, blocks show the bits of the value.

string.name: cap_text_blob_s06_desc
string.value: Place each glyph on a circle to show per glyph layout.

string.name: cap_text_blob_s07_desc
string.value: Scale through the canvas, the blob stays vector sharp.

string.name: cap_typography_group_desc
string.value: Layout, align, truncate, space, decorate, shadow, path layout, metrics and break strategy.

string.name: cap_typography_s00_desc
string.value: Default style laid out at a fixed width, the baseline for others.

string.name: cap_typography_s01_desc
string.value: The align field decides where each line sits inside the width.

string.name: cap_typography_s02_desc
string.value: Beyond MaxLines the rest is dropped and DidExceedMaxLines is true.

string.name: cap_typography_s03_desc
string.value: With a max line count the overflow ends with an ellipsis.

string.name: cap_typography_s04_desc
string.value: Letter and word spacing change the measured line width.

string.name: cap_typography_s05_desc
string.value: Underline, overline and line through combine with five styles.

string.name: cap_typography_s06_desc
string.value: A TextShadow on the style paints under the glyphs.

string.name: cap_typography_s07_desc
string.value: TypographyPaintOnPath lays the text along a path.

string.name: cap_typography_s08_desc
string.value: Per line indents shift the first and following lines.

string.name: cap_typography_s09_desc
string.value: Read each line height and width, then draw rects and baselines.

string.name: cap_typography_s10_desc
string.value: Greedy fills each line, the other two balance line lengths.

string.name: cap_typography_s11_desc
string.value: The weight steps from 300 to 900, the glyph gets heavier.

string.name: cap_typography_s12_desc
string.value: RTL reverses the inline order, start and end align follow it.

string.name: cap_typography_s13_desc
string.value: TypographyGetTextLines hands back lines painted one by one.

string.name: topic_animation_group_desc
string.value: Frame timer interpolation for scale, rotation and translation without framework animation APIs.

string.name: topic_animation_s00_desc
string.value: Scale runs from 1 to the target with an ease-out curve.

string.name: topic_animation_s01_desc
string.value: Rotation runs from 0 to the target angle in degrees.

string.name: topic_animation_s02_desc
string.value: Translation runs from 0 to the target offset in vp.

string.name: topic_animation_s03_desc
string.value: A fixed target with a variable duration shows the per frame budget.

string.name: topic_blur_group_desc
string.value: Background, content and foreground blur on one canvas node, with radius control.

string.name: topic_blur_s00_desc
string.value: backgroundBlur blurs whatever sits behind the canvas.

string.name: topic_blur_s01_desc
string.value: contentBlur blurs the canvas content itself.

string.name: topic_blur_s02_desc
string.value: foregroundBlur blurs what overlaps the canvas front layer.

string.name: topic_blur_s03_desc
string.value: Sweep the radius to see where the blur saturates.

string.name: topic_frame_tick_group_desc
string.value: Periodic redraw driven by a timer, plus a manual invalidate budget for comparison.

string.name: topic_frame_tick_s00_desc
string.value: One redraw every sixteen milliseconds approximates a sixty hertz frame.

string.name: topic_frame_tick_s01_desc
string.value: Thirty three milliseconds approximates a thirty hertz frame.

string.name: topic_frame_tick_s02_desc
string.value: Switch the toggle to stop the periodic timer.

string.name: topic_frame_tick_s03_desc
string.value: Manual invalidate calls give a baseline for the tick counter.

string.name: topic_hit_test_group_desc
string.value: Touch coordinates mapped back to the child node index under the finger.

string.name: topic_hit_test_s00_desc
string.value: Tap the canvas and the status bar reports which child was hit.

string.name: topic_hit_test_s01_desc
string.value: Padding grows the hit area beyond the child frame.

string.name: topic_hit_test_s02_desc
string.value: A column layout keeps the same hit logic with vertical stacking.

string.name: topic_hit_test_s03_desc
string.value: Switch the toggle to clear the accumulated touch counter.

string.name: topic_lifecycle_group_desc
string.value: Rebuild the host, dispose and rebuild again, reset the counters and inspect the node label.

string.name: topic_lifecycle_s00_desc
string.value: rebuild asks NodeContainer to call makeNode one more time.

string.name: topic_lifecycle_s01_desc
string.value: dispose releases the render nodes, rebuild creates them again.

string.name: topic_lifecycle_s02_desc
string.value: Clear the draw and touch counters without touching the tree.

string.name: topic_lifecycle_s03_desc
string.value: The label string is attached to the canvas render node.

string.name: topic_multi_device_group_desc
string.value: Row and column layouts, px versus vp length units and density scaling for different screens.

string.name: topic_multi_device_s00_desc
string.value: A tight row fits more children on a narrow screen.

string.name: topic_multi_device_s01_desc
string.value: A column stack uses the extra height of a wide screen.

string.name: topic_multi_device_s02_desc
string.value: lengthMetricsUnit switches the same numbers between vp and px.

string.name: topic_multi_device_s03_desc
string.value: Scale plus inset simulates a coarser screen density.

string.name: topic_node_tree_group_desc
string.value: Append, insert, remove and re-layout child RenderNodes on one host frame node.

string.name: topic_node_tree_s00_desc
string.value: rebuildBoxes appends children in one pass; gap sets the spacing between them.

string.name: topic_node_tree_s01_desc
string.value: insertChildAfter puts a new child right after the given index.

string.name: topic_node_tree_s02_desc
string.value: removeChild detaches one child, clearChildren drops them all.

string.name: topic_node_tree_s03_desc
string.value: The same children re-flow between a row and a column layout.

string.name: topic_performance_group_desc
string.value: Invalidate bursts, node count cost and periodic redraw load measured from the UI thread.

string.name: topic_performance_s00_desc
string.value: One burst of invalidate calls, timed from the first to the last.

string.name: topic_performance_s01_desc
string.value: The same burst over a larger node set shows the per node cost.

string.name: topic_performance_s02_desc
string.value: A periodic timer keeps redrawing while the page stays alive.

string.name: topic_performance_s03_desc
string.value: Switch the toggle to stop the periodic timer again.

string.name: topic_record_group_desc
string.value: Record an opacity ramp, then replay the recorded steps as frame by frame updates.

string.name: topic_record_s00_desc
string.value: Record between one and thirty two opacity steps into the buffer.

string.name: topic_record_s01_desc
string.value: Replay the recorded buffer exactly once.

string.name: topic_record_s02_desc
string.value: Replay the recorded buffer several times in a row.

string.name: topic_record_s03_desc
string.value: Switch the toggle to drop everything in the record buffer.

string.name: topic_render_prop_group_desc
string.value: Opacity, scale, rotation, translation, shadow and border applied to every child node.

string.name: topic_render_prop_s00_desc
string.value: Opacity is applied to each child in the same pass.

string.name: topic_render_prop_s01_desc
string.value: Scale and rotation share one transform call on every child.

string.name: topic_render_prop_s02_desc
string.value: Translation shifts the whole child set inside the canvas.

string.name: topic_render_prop_s03_desc
string.value: Shadow radius, alpha, corner radius and border width in one scene.
